_comment: KNOB REGISTRY for iBIOM_CropMapping & Pasture-Livestock WKUBE Routine.
Run `Rscript tools/gen_config.R` after editing this file to regenerate:

knobs.name: TASK
knobs.label: Workflow Task
knobs.desc: Execution task: 'trial' runs P00_check_env.R + main_pasture.R for AT, NL, ES in 2018; 'pasture' runs the pasture & ruminant livestock downscaling pipeline; 'cropland' runs main.R; 'all' runs both pasture and cropland pipelines; 'check' runs P00_check_env.R only.

knobs.name: YEARS
knobs.label: Reference Year(s)
knobs.desc: Comma-separated LAMASUS LUM reference year(s) from {2000, 2010, 2018}, or 'all' to run 2000,2010,2018.

knobs.name: COUNTRIES
knobs.label: Country Subset (NUTS0)
knobs.desc: Comma-separated NUTS0 country codes (e.g. 'AT,NL,ES'), or 'all' for all mapped EU countries (excluding CY which has 0 pixels). Trial mode defaults 'all' to 'AT,NL,ES'.

knobs.name: RESULT_TAG
knobs.label: Result Run Tag
knobs.desc: Run identifier used to scope output/<RESULT_TAG>/ subdirectories and output filenames.

knobs.name: LUM_DIR
knobs.label: Hosted LUM Root Directory
knobs.desc: Root folder containing <year>/ibiom_LUM_europe_100m_<year>.tif (on WKUBE: /mnt/wdrv/iBIOM_Explorer/Land_use_and_management; auto-falls back to ~/accelerator/mnt/ibiom/... or input/LUM_data locally).

knobs.name: WORK_DIR
knobs.label: Persistent Output Work Directory
knobs.desc: Persistent shared storage directory under /mnt/wdrv where output/ is redirected so the WKUBE uploader collects artifacts.

knobs.name: SHARED_INPUT_DIR
knobs.label: Shared Preprocessed Input Directory
knobs.desc: Shared drive location holding prepared non-LUM input .rds artifacts (EPIC_grass_params.rds, FAOSTAT accounts, Eurostat priors, 1 km grid mapping).

knobs.name: OUTPUT_DIR
knobs.label: Relative Output Directory Name
knobs.desc: Output directory name inside the app root (symlinked to $WORK_DIR/$OUTPUT_DIR when WORK_DIR is on /mnt/wdrv).

knobs.name: LIVESTOCK_SOURCE
knobs.label: Livestock Accounting Source
knobs.desc: National livestock herd, production, and excretion accounting source ('faostat' QCL/GLE/EMN/EK).

knobs.name: EMISSION_SOURCE
knobs.label: FAOSTAT GLE Emission Inventory Source
knobs.desc: Inventory series selected from FAOSTAT GLE livestock emissions ('FAO TIER 1' has complete EU coverage; 'UNFCCC' where reported).

knobs.name: USE_EUROSTAT_PRIORS
knobs.label: Use Eurostat NUTS2 Priors
knobs.desc: Use Eurostat NUTS2 livestock species shares (ef_lsk_*) and milk yields (agr_r_milkpr) as spatial priors in cascadecore::fienberg IPF ('1' = enabled, '0' = uniform national baseline).

knobs.name: GWP_VERSION
knobs.label: IPCC GWP100 Metric Version
knobs.desc: 100-year Global Warming Potential weights for CH4 and N2O ('AR6': 27/273, 'AR5': 28/265, 'AR4': 25/298).

knobs.name: EXPORT_SPATIAL
knobs.label: Export Spatial Country Outputs
knobs.desc: Export 24-band COG GeoTIFF, EPSG:3035 1 km centroid GeoPackage, and Apache Arrow Parquet per country ('1' = enabled, '0' = RDS/CSV only).

knobs.name: SKIP_EXISTING
knobs.label: Skip Completed Country Outputs
knobs.desc: Set to '1' to resume an interrupted run by skipping countries whose atomic RDS file already exists in output/<RESULT_TAG>/.

knobs.name: FORCE_PREP
knobs.label: Force Re-preparation Steps
knobs.desc: Optional comma-separated preparation step names to re-run even if outputs exist (e.g. 'EPIC_grass,faostat_accounts,eurostat_priors'). Leave empty to reuse prepared inputs.

knobs.name: NCORES
knobs.label: Worker CPU Threads
knobs.desc: Number of CPU threads/cores allocated to the container (data.table / GDAL threads; BLAS threads remain pinned to 1).

knobs.name: TRIAL
knobs.label: Trial Verification Mode
knobs.desc: When '1' (or when TASK='trial'), scopes run to YEARS='2018' and COUNTRIES='AT,NL,ES' (if COUNTRIES is 'all') for fast end-to-end verification.
